title: Windows 11 Error
blurb: Windows errors used to shout. This one clears its throat. Windows 11 continued the long softening of Microsoft's alert design, swapping the panicky ding of the XP years for something rounded and almost apologetic, so being told you cannot do a thing now feels closer to a polite suggestion. Anyone on a modern PC recognises it within a single note, and that instant recognition is what makes it land when you drop it into an edit at the moment somebody does something obviously, avoidably wrong. Free MP3 for your next fail compilation.
origin: The system error sound from Windows 11.
